newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER - SENT-OFF ITALIAN KISSES WOMAN REFEREE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - SENT-OFF ITALIAN KISSES WOMAN REFEREE.

text.p: An Italian soccer player who was sent off by a female referee after picking up two bookings replied by kissing her on both cheeks.

Striker Alessandro Veronese, 26, was first booked for hand ball and then for taking off his shirt after scoring for Battaglia in their 2-0 amateur league win over Rocca at the weekend, the ANSA news agency reported on Tuesday.
Veronese first shook medical student Anna Di Toni by the hand and then kissed her twice.
